verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Canny serves an llms.txt at developers.canny.io (HTTP 200) titled "Canny Developer Documentation," so an agent can be pointed at it. Beyond that probe, the evidence is thin: only the file's header is visible, and no first-party page documents or describes the agent-oriented docs. The MCP server is a separate capability and is not credited here. missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's actual content and completeness (e.g., coverage of API reference, SDK and widget docs), an llms-full.txt or markdown-rendered doc pages, first-party documentation announcing agent-oriented docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://developers.canny.io/llms.txt # Canny Developer Documentation
